briefings.message: Reid Detmers is the medium-confidence starter prediction. Right-handed hitters, look for his fastball; lefties, stay disciplined against sliders and curveballs below the zone. reminders: Fernando Tatis Jr. leads off; Jackson Merrill starts despite the rest suggestion.

briefings.headline: Keep Trout off the heart and use fresh arms first
briefings.message: Michael King is the only ready starter. Keep fastballs out of the heart against Mike Trout, and work breaking balls below the zone to Zach Neto. Stay off the middle to Jo Adell; do not treat him as an easy out. Use the changeup and sweeper below the zone against left-handed hitters and right-handed threats such as Jorge Soler; Soler’s offspeed sample is small. If King exits early, go to long relief, then rested middle arms. Protect Mason Miller and Adrian Morejon after yesterday’s outings; use them only when needed late.
reminders: King’s pitch-count limit is 90; expected innings are 5.0.
Kyle Hart and Bradgley Rodriguez are available rested options.
